title: The first algorithm ran only on paper
body: In 1843 Ada Lovelace published notes on Babbage's Analytical Engine, including a method to compute Bernoulli numbers. The Engine was never completed, so her program ran only on paper. It still counts: she saw that a machine manipulating symbols could go beyond arithmetic, an idea far ahead of the hardware.
source_hint: Lovelace's notes on the Analytical Engine, 1843
